source.rule: RBDTreeStructure.MBOPM/SBOPM select operational modes for mother/subblock. MaterielOperationalModes.USERT controls relative usage and is multiplicative across RBD levels.

configuration.parent: Accepted G08 A-root NBREQ2 B/C/D leaf tree with physical B/A OPHOURS failures, h8-34 mission, direct half-hour CM, seed1, one replication/horizon36; all edges G04-OPS and positions USERT1.
configuration.mother75: Define G08-A-75; add POS-A mode row USERT0.75 and select it in MBOPM of every A-to-leaf edge. SBOPM stays G04-OPS.
configuration.sub75: Define G08-B-75; add POS-B mode row USERT0.75 and select it only in SBOPM of the A-to-B edge. MBOPM stays G04-OPS.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms import/export/calculate with zero converter errors or unreviewed diagnostics, preserving all populated authored tables exactly.

Each selected 0.75 mode changes at least one native B/A failure time or order relative to the full-rate parent. Event identity/order/timing are empirical; no matched stochastic draw or monotonic law is assumed. If an arm has no native timing difference or converter rejection, retain it as diagnostic and revise under a new version.

Native logs report system criticality and mission outcome but may not print selected MBOPM/SBOPM or individual usage rates. Any observed failure and mission sequence must reconcile with the source-defined tree and 72-bin reports.
native_acceptance: Two unique serial guarded session-0 SSH runs with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Compare event identity/order/timing and report to accepted full-rate control without claiming common random draws; independent read-only replay.
diagnostic_gate: Retain any rejected arm and raw evidence as diagnostic; revise with new version/run IDs rather than changing a frozen hypothesis.
limits: One 0.75-rate mode on root A via MBOPM or leaf B via SBOPM in a single A-root tree, one seed/replication; other positions, rates, nested modes and population behavior untested.
Selected mode and path state are source-bound because native log may not print them. No GUI drawing, online maintenance or cross-engine claim.
